official_measurement_examples.name: Predictive ALC July 2026
official_measurement_examples.fact: Defra's Predictive Agricultural Land Classification Map was updated 1 July 2026 and provides a strategic-scale national prediction, including subdivision of Grade 3.

official_measurement_examples.name: BMV definition
official_measurement_examples.fact: Grades 1, 2 and 3a are best and most versatile agricultural land; Grade 3b is not BMV.

official_measurement_examples.name: Strategic map limitation
official_measurement_examples.fact: The predictive map is strategic scale and must not substitute for a detailed site survey where parcel-level grading is material.

official_measurement_examples.name: Consultation threshold context
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England consultation duties for large non-agricultural development on BMV land depend on statutory circumstances and development-plan conformity, not polygon intersection alone.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning weight not prohibition
official_measurement_examples.fact: BMV land is a planning consideration with economic and other benefits; it is not an automatic development prohibition.

official_measurement_examples.name: Soil and land quality distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: Agricultural land grade measures inherent agricultural capability and is not a title, ownership, access or development-capacity record.

official_measurement_examples.name: Historic versus predictive evidence
official_measurement_examples.fact: Older provisional ALC mapping and the 2026 predictive layer must retain source, scale and version rather than being silently treated as identical evidence.

official_measurement_examples.name: Parcel promotion guard
official_measurement_examples.fact: No parcel BMV clearance or Future Growth score is promoted while runner recovery remains parked.

core_rules: predictive ALC is strategic evidence not parcel survey
Grades 1 2 and 3a are BMV while 3b is distinct
ALC grade is not planning permission
BMV status is not automatic refusal
consultation requirements retain proposal scale and policy context
historic and predictive ALC versions remain distinct
ALC geometry is not cadastral ownership
land quality does not determine infrastructure capacity
no parcel promotion while recovery is parked
source_verification_note: Official Defra, Natural England, Planning Data, GOV.UK and legislation sources checked on 2026-07-26. The 1 July 2026 Predictive ALC update and BMV/site-survey distinctions were retained; no parcel promotion.
